text:
samir: FYI — Marlin (cust-marlin) reported ~35% throughput drop since last Friday. Support opened ticket #23489. They see sustained lower tokens/s and increased queue times. Anyone available to triage?

kristin: On it. Can you paste the ticket link and which cluster/pool is affected?

samir: Ticket: https://redwood.support/tickets/23489. Affected: prod-eu / dedicated-pool-15. Screenshot shows p50 ~ same, p99 up ~300ms, overall throughput down ~35%. Attachments: perf snapshot + flame graphs.

ajay: Was there a deploy in the window? @deploy-bot any deploy events around 2026-03-14 22:00Z?

deploy-bot: Deployed revision r2026.3.14 to prod-eu at 2026-03-14T22:10Z (deploy id d-4428). Canary started 22:05Z.

maria: I'll run a quick benchmark against a canary node. Repro command I use: `./perf_tool --host prod-eu --pool dedicated-pool-15 --model redwood-v2 --qps 50 --seq 512 --duration 3m`

samir: Also check kernel-selector logs, KV cache hit rates, and whether requests fell back to a different model variant (quantized vs fp16). Auto-switching could explain tail jumps.

ajay: Looking at metrics briefly — I see a CPU and network spike on host 10.2.5.12 at 22:02Z, and several TCP retransmits in that window. Could be host-level NIC or kernel issue, not model change. Dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/internal/dashboards/marlin-23489

kristin: Gathering `dmesg` and `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv` from pool-15 nodes now. Enabling detailed runtime profiling for 1 hour on the affected nodes.

support-bot: Support note: Customer throttled traffic to 30% and requested ETA. Ticket updated with our initial triage.

maria: Quick bench result: ran perf_tool against node 10.2.5.12 at 50 qps. Observed median token latency +12ms but p99 spikes ~+280ms correlated with KV miss bursts. Full log: /tmp/marlin_bench.log (uploaded to ticket).

ajay: Assigning owners: @samir and @kristin for runtime/node triage. If infra, escalate to oncall infra.

samir: @dave (oncall-infra) can you check 10.2.5.12 NIC stats and kernel logs? Suspect retransmits/noisy neighbor.

dave: Looking now. I see driver warnings and retransmits 22:03-22:12. Kicking the host into maintenance and draining. Will reprovision and monitor.

kristin: After draining 10.2.5.12 and shifting traffic, p99 returned to baseline across the pool. That suggests a single-host noisy neighbor / NIC issue. I'll open a follow-up to harden placement (spread allocations across racks) and add an alert for per-host retransmit spikes.

samir: Nice. Please update ticket #23489 with findings and mark as hardware-related if confirmed. If infra confirms, set postmortem flag. :white_check_mark: :rotating_light:

maria: I'll follow up with a short runbook entry for performing this quick triage (perf command, metrics to check, logs to grab).

samir: Thanks all — keep updates in the ticket. If customer needs immediate SLA note, we should offer a short credits/mitigation while infra completes reprovisioning.
